history.sg_progress: With regard to the recommendation on this matter and the request of the General Assembly, as set out in its resolution 76/272, the Secretary-General has proposed in his report on improving the financial situation of the United Nations (A/79/734) additional options for dealing with the liquidity situation, to be presented to the Assembly at its seventy-ninth session, earlier than the planned eightieth session, in view of the deteriorating liquidity situation for both the regular and peacekeeping budgets. The Administration considers this recommendation to have been implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
